title: Jilted, Made a Concubine, and Swapped Bodies with the Prince of Chu
author: Wuyue You
synopsis: On the day of her grand wedding, Xue Wanyao's bridal sedan chair was struck by lightning and tumbled into the water. Passing by, the young Prince of Chu noticed the bride falling into the water with no one to save her, so he jumped in and rescued her. When Xue Wanyao arrived at the gates of the Wuding Marquis Residence in her soaked wedding dress, she unexpectedly heard orders for the bridal sedan chair to turn back. Her prospective mother-in-law, the Marchioness of Wuding, had always valued her own pristine reputation; disgusted that Xue Wanyao had fallen into the water and been saved by another man, thus losing her reputation, she demanded to call off the marriage in public. Having no other choice, Xue Wanyao had to return to the Xue family, only to be driven out by her family, who equally valued their pristine reputation, on the grounds that she had lost hers. Two paths lay before Xue Wanyao: one was to commit suicide to preserve her reputation, and the other was to go to a Taoist temple to become a nun.
